summary: Uses the organization’s sign-in policy for project and engine member invitations.
userImpact: Project and engine invitation dialogs offer the delivery methods allowed by the current organization.

changes: Invitation capability reads and invitation creation and reissue use the resolved tenant context.

security: The authenticated tenant context determines the invitation scope. Existing role and sign-in policy checks still apply.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible backend image.
validation: Project and engine member route tests cover tenant-scoped capability and invitation inputs.

customerDocumentation.reason: The invitation workflow uses the existing organization sign-in and email settings.
